donor_policies.outside_ab: Admitted conventional HY with frozen corrected generator landing outside electrical zones A and B; exclude2693/2694 and all PS.
donor_policies.all_other: All other admitted conventional HY; exclude2693/2694 and all PS. Balancing-location sensitivity, not the preferred western-cut isolation.

target_policies.legacy_literal: RMN = 0.8 * public P63 Hydro - fixed current StLawrence PG. Literal requested target; infeasible hours unavailable. This is a partial legacy-share recipe, not a complete 2019-method swap.
target_policies.legacy_bounded: Project the legacy hypothesis target into the hourly jointly feasible RMN interval. Record requested/applied differences; source observations are never rewritten.
target_policies.month_shape_literal: EIA2693 full-month net MWh / physical local-calendar month hours, times baselineRMN/mean(baselineRMN on the fixed eligible month cohort). Reject infeasible hourly requests.
target_policies.month_shape_constrained: Nearest unweighted hourly vector to that same monthly-shaped request, subject to joint hourly RMN intervals and exact cohort sum = source monthly mean * fixed eligible hours. An infeasible monthly sum rejects the whole affected cohort month.

balancing_objective: For each feasible hourly RMN and donor aggregate, minimize0.5*sum(original objective_weight*(unitPG-current baselinePG)^2) within original native unit bounds.
conserved_total: Current baseline hourly statewide Hydro PG, including fixed PS; the P63 Hydro source is separately exposed and is not substituted for this preserved total.
monthly_scope: America/New_York physical calendar hours (March743, November721). Source EIA monthly energy is rescaled to the fixed eligible-hour count by a representative-missing-hours assumption. No full-month or full-year energy claim for incomplete cohorts.
fixed_cohort_policy: Main comparisons require all8651fixedhours. Literal/infeasible variants remain restricted diagnostics; no error-based hour selection or silent filling.

output_contract.reconstruction: Load the hash-bound all-boundary baseline, overwrite gen_rows_1based with gen_pg_changed, and set every PG row outside qualified to NaN.
